latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of "Video Online Free — Edit and Export Videos Online".

- Upload, edit, and export MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM videos (up to 500MB) entirely online — no installs or subscriptions needed.
- Simple setup: automatic cloud session creation; 100 free credits for anonymous users.
- Supports editing actions like trim, add background music, text overlays, and 1080p MP4 export.
- Fast cloud-based processing: edit and render short clips (under 3 minutes) in about 1-2 minutes.
- API responds to plain language editing instructions; supports batch uploads and iterative editing workflows.
- Exports in common formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, etc.) and handles most common video-student/creator needs.
